title: fix(components): ungrouped fields render as their own block, not under the last group's heading (objectui#11777)
body:
Fixes #11777
Clause-②: no

Implemented by the `domain:ui#1` seat's dispatched dev, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01DrKzdPdyLLBW3qpZ4vtk7z`, on branch `claude/issue-11777-ungrouped-form-section`.

## What was wrong

On an object where one declared `fieldGroups` entry holds some fields and the rest join no group, every stacked form arm drew the ungrouped fields under the last group's heading. The spec's `deriveFieldGroupLayout` (ADR-0085 §5) is right: it emits the declared groups, then a separate untitled bucket, trailing. By the one row rule (objectui#9849, director ruling letter E: a divider row exists iff `title || description`) that bucket gets no row, and every arm flattens all sections into one field list that the form renderer drew in ONE grid. So the bucket's fields continued in the same grid as the heading, and in a two-column form the first ungrouped field even sat in the same row as the group's last member.

## Landing site: the form renderer, not `plugin-form` (measured)

The PM expected `packages/plugin-form/src/fieldGroups.ts` and the arms. Measurement put the producer of the one grid one package lower: `@object-ui/components`' form renderer draws the untabbed, unpaned field list as `fields.map(renderFormField)` inside a single `fieldGridClass` container, and the only per-field DOM a `plugin-form` arm controls is the `colSpan` class and the `section-divider` row. Inside the fence (no new prop, export or type member of `@object-ui/plugin-form` or `@object-ui/types`, no locale key) and the ruling (no row, heading or placeholder title for the untitled bucket), no `plugin-form`-only change can give the bucket a container of its own.

The renderer already has the signal it needs. Every heading row the arms emit through `projectSectionDivider` carries the objectui#6236 membership claim (`fields`: the section's resolved members), which `@object-ui/types` declares as the fields "that belong to the section this divider heads". So:

- `splitAtUntitledRuns` (new, module-private in `packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`) splits the field list where a field follows a heading that does not claim it, and where a row that draws nothing (a headingless section's gate row) follows one. Each block renders in its own `fieldGridClass` container, inside the same one form.
- The untitled block is set off by `UNTITLED_BLOCK_CLASS` (`mt-4 border-t border-border pt-4`) on its own container: no row, no heading text, no placeholder title. It is applied only when something above it was drawn, so a form whose titled sections are all hidden does not open on a stray rule.
- A form that needs one block renders exactly the DOM it rendered before: a flat form, titled sections only, untitled fields before the first heading, and a heading without a claim (the pre-#6236 contract) all stay one container.
- Placement is unchanged: the untitled block still trails the groups, as the spec orders.

`plugin-form` gets comment-only edits (`projectSectionDivider`'s `fields` bullet now says the renderer reads the claim for block boundaries; the `SimpleObjectForm` loop comment no longer says the bucket "renders flat"). The guide gets one bullet in `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx` (Section rows).

⚠️ For the seat: `packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`, its new test and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx` are outside the claim's file surface. The dispatch order says to fix the producer where measurement finds it and to name the site here; the claim says a file outside its list is reported before the PR opens. Both are honoured as far as one run can: this PR is a draft, and the report names the conflict.

## The designer (H3): already the same rule, untouched

Both designer surfaces already draw the ungrouped fields as their own trailing area: `ObjectFormDesigner` orders its containers as the declared groups followed by the ungrouped bucket (`containerOrder`), and `ObjectFormCanvas` groups through `groupEntries`, which inserts the declared groups first and the ungrouped bucket on the first ungrouped field, each section in its own `GroupSection`. The "Ungrouped" title there is the editing canvas's drop-zone label, not a runtime heading. Neither file is changed.

## Real-layout reading (dev-only harness, not committed)

ModalForm create dialog (the arm `?form=new` opens: `AppContent` mounts the global `ModalForm`), Chromium at 1440x900, the filer's object: `fieldGroups: [{ key: 'new_group', label: 'New group' }]`, only `name` in the group, `status`, `due_date`, `problem_description`, `technician` ungrouped.

| reading | before (base `9990f9e`) | after |
|---|---|---|
| field grid containers in the form | 1 (`grid gap-4 grid-cols-1 @md:grid-cols-2`) | 2 |
| fields in the heading's container | all 5 | `name` only |
| `name` box (x, y) | 257, 294 | 257, 285 |
| `status` box (x, y) | 728, 294 (same row as `name`) | 257, 382 (new row) |
| untitled container border-top | none | 1px solid |

The unit-level measurement of the derivation (H1) on the same object: `[{"name":"new_group","label":"New group","fields":["name"]},{"fields":["status","due_date","problem_description","technician"]}]`. DOM reading in happy-dom before the fix (H2): on ObjectForm, ModalForm and DrawerForm the `status` and `technician` items shared the heading's container; after it, none do.

## Pins

- `packages/components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/form-untitled-run-block-11777.test.tsx` (12 rows): the filer's shape; the boundary is drawn on the untitled block and nothing else is; one form still submits every block; controls (flat, titled only, untitled before the first heading, claim-less heading) stay one block; a headingless gate row opens a block; collapsed and predicate-hidden titled sections; an all-hidden untitled run draws no boundary; an untitled section between two titled ones.
- `packages/plugin-form/src/ungroupedFieldSection-11777.test.tsx` (6 rows x 3 arms: ObjectForm, ModalForm, DrawerForm, each on its own): the filer's object; no field grouped stays flat; every field grouped stays one block; `collapse: 'collapsed'` gates only the group's member and opening it from its heading brings it back into the group's block; a group `visibleWhen` gates only the group's member; an explicit untitled section after a titled one.

## Reverse verification (committed first, then reverted)

At `a3d47d7`, `form.tsx` was checked out from base `9990f9e` (marker `splitAtUntitledRuns` count 4 to 0; reverted blob equals the base blob `9c47e4b`), both pin files run, then restored with `git checkout HEAD -- ` the path (restored blob equals the HEAD blob `58a99c8`, `git diff HEAD` empty).

- reverted: `Test Files 2 failed (2)`, `Tests 15 failed | 15 passed (30)`. Red, in the predicted direction: the six separation rows of the renderer file and three rows on each arm (the filer's object, collapse, explicit untitled section). Green, as predicted: every control, the submit row and both predicate rows.
- restored: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 30 passed (30)`.

The resolution path is the source: the root `vitest.config.mts` aliases `@object-ui/components` to `packages/components/src`, so no rebuild sits between the revert and the run.

## Changeset

`.changeset/11777-ungrouped-form-section.md`: `@object-ui/components` patch (the behaviour) and `@object-ui/plugin-form` patch (its `src/` comments). The order named `@object-ui/plugin-form` only; the renderer is where the behaviour changed. No `@object-ui/app-shell` entry: the designer is untouched.

## Acceptance notes

- `SplitForm` with more than one pane draws each pane's field list in the pane's own container, which this split does not reach. Inside one pane, a titled section followed by an untitled one would still share that pane's grid. Read from source only, not reproduced at a public entry; noted here, no card.
- Tab panels draw only their own section's fields (no divider rows), so nothing there needs the split.
- The rule reads the claim the arms already emit. A future arm that emits a heading row without `fields` keeps the pre-#6236 behaviour (one block), and the `projectSectionDivider` doc now says so at the producer.
